attack_quote: When requests to these servers failed, new connections were opened immediately, which increased the number of connections and the memory they used.

contributing_factors.source_quote: Some servers in our event streaming platform were close to their memory limits, and memory use on these servers grows with the number of client connections.
contributing_factors.text: Some event streaming servers were already close to their memory limits, and their memory use grows with the number of client connections.

contributing_factors.source_quote: Those servers then became overloaded too, and the problem spread to more servers over the following hour.
contributing_factors.text: Taking overloaded servers out of service moved their traffic to other servers, which became overloaded too, so the problem spread over the following hour.

contributing_factors.source_quote: The service that writes audit log events kept restarting on errors from the platform for more than two hours and fell further behind.
contributing_factors.text: The service that writes audit log events kept restarting on errors from the platform for more than two hours and fell further behind.

contributing_factors.source_quote: Once stabilized, it could only write events at a limited rate, so the backlog took several more hours to clear.
contributing_factors.text: Once stabilized, the audit log service could only write events at a limited rate, so the backlog took several more hours to clear.

fixes.source_quote: We began rebalancing overloaded partitions onto brokers that had available capacity and this mitigated the issue.
fixes.text: Rebalanced overloaded partitions onto brokers with available capacity, which mitigated the issue.

fixes.source_quote: We added randomized delays to reconnects after a failed request
fixes.text: Add randomized delays to reconnects after a failed request.

fixes.source_quote: We are alerting earlier on server memory use, so we can move traffic before a server slows down.
fixes.text: Alert earlier on server memory use, to move traffic before a server slows down.

fixes.source_quote: We are adding a second destination for webhook delivery data that we can switch to
fixes.text: Add a second destination for webhook delivery data to switch to if the event streaming platform slows down.

fixes.source_quote: We have improved our playbooks to move hot partitions for similar situations in the future
fixes.text: Improve playbooks to move hot partitions.

root_cause.source_quote: When requests to these servers failed, new connections were opened immediately, which increased the number of connections and the memory they used.
root_cause.text: Servers in GitHub's event streaming platform, already close to their memory limits, were overloaded when failed requests made clients open new connections immediately, raising connection counts and memory use; this delayed pull request updates, Actions workflow status updates, webhook deliveries, and audit log events.

timeline.event: The incident begins: delays in pull request updates, Actions workflow status updates, and webhook deliveries.
The incident is resolved once audit log delays are back within the healthy range: 14:52 UTC plus the stated 4 hours and 30 minutes.
timeline.source_quote: We resolved the incident once audit log delays were back within the healthy range, and the remaining backlog cleared afterward.

timeline.event: Audit log events are fully caught up: 14:52 UTC plus the stated 6 hours and 46 minutes.
timeline.source_quote: Audit log events were fully caught up after about 6 hours and 46 minutes.
timeline.time_as_written: 14:52 UTC, after about 6 hours and 46 minutes
